summary: id Software's 3D arena-shooter franchise, spanning dark-fantasy Quake, the Strogg storyline, arena multiplayer, and modern enhanced re-releases.

entries.title: Quake

emulation.notes: Native enhanced PC release; DOSBox/source ports only for historical builds.

primary.why: The enhanced release includes the original campaign, both classic mission packs, Dimension of the Past, Dimension of the Machine, modern rendering, split-screen/local and online multiplayer, and cross-play.
primary.how_to_play: Play the enhanced PC release on Steam, GOG, Microsoft Store, or Game Pass; preserve the build with its bundled episodes and add-ons.

entries.remaster_caveats: Legacy console ports are interesting but not required for unique campaign content when using the enhanced PC release.

entries.title: Quake II

primary.why: The 2023 enhanced release bundles Quake II, The Reckoning, Ground Zero, Quake II 64, and Call of the Machine with modern graphics and cross-play.
primary.how_to_play: Play the enhanced PC release on Steam, GOG, Microsoft Store, or Game Pass; preserve the bundled campaigns and add-ons.

entries.remaster_caveats: Quake II RTX is a separate path-tracing showcase and is cataloged separately.

entries.title: Quake II RTX
entries.definitive_edition: Quake II RTX for visual showcase; Quake II Enhanced for complete main run

primary.why: Quake II RTX is NVIDIA's path-traced version of Quake II; Windows is the easiest RTX hardware/software route.
primary.how_to_play: Play on Windows with capable RTX/path-tracing hardware; use the full campaign only if you own Quake II data.

entries.remaster_caveats: Do not use RTX as the sole Quake II archive route if expansion completeness matters.

entries.title: Quake III Arena

primary.why: Quake III Arena is a PC-first arena shooter with many console ports; Windows/source-port play is the best competitive and archival route.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release or ioquake3-style source-port setup with original data; document server/mod state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Team Arena is cataloged separately as the official expansion release.

entries.title: Quake III: Team Arena

primary.why: Team Arena is the official Quake III expansion focused on team modes; Windows/source-port play is the best route.
primary.how_to_play: Install Team Arena data alongside Quake III Arena on Windows or a compatible source port.

entries.remaster_caveats: Requires Quake III Arena data/install context.

entries.title: Quake 4

primary.why: Quake 4 shipped on Windows, Linux, OS X, and Xbox 360; Windows is the best preservation route with modern fixes.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with the latest patch and compatibility fixes as needed.

entries.remaster_caveats: No official modern remaster is sourced.

entries.title: Enemy Territory: Quake Wars
entries.definitive_edition: Windows PC release with final patches

primary.why: Enemy Territory: Quake Wars shipped on Windows, Linux, OS X, PS3, and Xbox 360; the PC version is the best route for input, fidelity, and any remaining server/community preservation.
primary.how_to_play: Play the Windows release with final patches and verify current server/community availability before archiving.

entries.remaster_caveats: Verify server/community state; this is not a single-player campaign-first entry.

entries.title: Quake Live

primary.why: Quake Live became a standalone Steam Windows title after originally launching as a browser-plug-in game.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Steam Windows release; document server, workshop, and ruleset state.

entries.remaster_caveats: Originally browser/free-to-play; now standalone paid release.

entries.title: Quake Champions

primary.why: Quake Champions is a Windows-only multiplayer arena shooter and remains a live/current-client preservation target.
primary.how_to_play: Play the current Windows client through Steam or Bethesda-supported launcher path; document update, server state, and battle pass/event status.

entries.remaster_caveats: Not a fixed-content release; revisit after major live updates.
